title: Enforcement Rule of the Act on Local Government Subsidy Management
title_original: 지방자치단체 보조금 관리에 관한 법률 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on Local Government Subsidy Management and its Enforcement Decree and matters necessary for their implementation.

Article 2 (Management of Local Government Subsidy Records)
(1) The head of a local government shall prepare a local government subsidized project management card in attached Form 1 pursuant to Article 6(3) of the Act on Local Government Subsidy Management (hereinafter referred to as the "Act"). However, a management card need not be prepared for a local government subsidized project to which local government subsidies totaling not more than 1 million won are granted within the same fiscal year (limited to a project performed by an individual). <Amended on December 13, 2023>
(2) The head of a local government shall register and manage the management card under paragraph (1) in the integrated local government subsidy management network under Article 28 of the Act.

Article 3 (Preparation of Performance Reports)
(1) The format, preparation method, and items of the performance report under the main sentence of Article 17(1) of the Act, excluding its subparagraphs, shall be as specified in attached Form 2. <Amended on December 13, 2023>
(2) A local government subsidized operator shall submit the performance report in attached Form 2 to the head of the local government together with the following documents:
1. A settlement report for the local government subsidized project in attached Form 3;
2. Documents determined by the head of the local government pursuant to the latter part of Article 17(1) of the Act, excluding its subparagraphs.

Article 4 (Preparation of Verification Reports)
(1) The format, preparation method, and items of a verification report prescribed under Article 10(2) of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on Local Government Subsidy Management (hereinafter referred to as the "Decree") shall be as specified in attached Form 4. <Amended on December 13, 2023>
(2) An auditor under subparagraph 7 of Article 2 and Article 9 of the Act on External Audit of Stock Companies, Etc. (hereinafter referred to as an "auditor") shall verify the following matters when preparing a verification report in attached Form 4:
1. Documents substantiating the execution and expenditure of local government subsidies;
2. The appropriateness of the procedures for concluding contracts for the local government subsidized project and the related supporting documents;
3. The appropriateness of the project plan for the local government subsidized project and of the execution of local government subsidies;
4. The accuracy of the calculation of interest accruing from local government subsidies;
5. Whether the conditions for granting local government subsidies under Article 9(1) of the Act have been violated, and the accuracy of amounts disallowed as a result of such violations;
6. Where the head of a local government has attached a condition requiring the return of all or part of a local government subsidy under Article 9(2) of the Act, the accuracy of the amount to be returned;
7. Where part of a local government subsidy has been carried forward following a change in the details of the local government subsidized project or the allocation of expenses with the approval of the head of the local government under Article 14 of the Act, the accuracy of the amount carried forward;
8. Whether the documents determined by the head of the local government under the latter part of Article 17(1) of the Act, excluding its subparagraphs, have been provided;
9. The accuracy of the unspent balance of local government subsidies and the amount of local government subsidies to be returned under Article 9(3) of the Decree.
(3) When a circumstance specified in any subparagraph of Article 17(1) of the Act arises, a local government subsidized operator shall submit to the head of the local government the performance report in attached Form 2 and the verification report in attached Form 4 (limited to cases where a verification report must be submitted under Article 17(2) of the Act).

Article 5 (Selection of Auditors by Specific Local Government Subsidized Operators)
(1) Where a specific local government subsidized operator under the main sentence of Article 18(1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as a "specific local government subsidized operator") selects an auditor under Article 11(1) of the Decree, the operator shall notify the head of the local government of the selection within one month from the date on which the audit contract with that auditor is concluded, together with the following documents. However, notification may be omitted where the auditor selected is the same person as the auditor selected for the immediately preceding business year subject to audit:
1. A copy of the audit contract with the auditor;
2. A certified copy of the corporate register of the specific local government subsidized operator (limited to cases where that operator is a corporation).
(2) Where any of the following circumstances arises with respect to an auditor selected under Article 11(1) of the Decree, a specific local government subsidized operator shall select a new auditor within two months from the date on which the circumstance arises:
1. Where the accounting firm serving as auditor is dissolved due to bankruptcy or any other cause. However, dissolution resulting from a merger or division is excluded;
2. Where the registration of the accounting firm serving as auditor or an audit team under item (b) of subparagraph 7 of Article 2 of the Act on External Audit of Stock Companies, Etc. (hereinafter referred to as an "audit team") has been revoked;
3. Where an accounting firm serving as auditor has been ordered to suspend its business (including where a member of an audit team has been ordered to suspend duties), rendering the accounting audit for the relevant business year impossible;
4. Where the auditor is effectively unable to conduct the accounting audit for the relevant business year for any other reason.
(3) Where an auditor falls under any of the following subparagraphs, a specific local government subsidized operator shall terminate the audit contract with the auditor without delay and select another auditor within two months from the date of termination:
1. Where the auditor violates Article 21 or 33 of the Certified Public Accountant Act;
2. Where the auditor breaches professional duties, including by divulging confidential information of the specific local government subsidized operator;
3. Where the auditor causes damage to the specific local government subsidized operator through neglect of duties;
4. Where the auditor makes an improper demand or exerts pressure in connection with the accounting audit.
(4) Where a specific local government subsidized operator fails to select an auditor by the deadline under Article 11(1) of the Decree, the head of the local government may require the operator to select an auditor.
(5) The head of a local government may require a specific local government subsidized operator to change its auditor in any of the following cases:
1. Where it is determined that the operator has replaced its auditor for an unjustifiable reason;
2. Where the operator has failed to select another auditor despite the existence of any ground specified in paragraph (3).

Article 6 (Documents Attached to Audit Reports)
The form for preparing documents concerning the matters that an auditor must attach, pursuant to the proviso to Article 11(3) of the Decree, to an audit report under the main sentence of Article 18(1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as an "audit report") shall be as specified in attached Form 5.

Article 7 (Supplementary Registration of Important Property)
(1) Where a local government subsidized operator intends to make a supplementary registration under the main sentence of Article 22(1) of the Act, excluding its subparagraphs, the operator shall submit a certificate of real estate supported by local government subsidies in attached Form 6 to the registry office.
(2) Where a local government subsidized operator intends to cancel a supplementary registration under Article 22(4) of the Act, the operator shall submit a certificate of real estate subject to cancellation of supplementary registration in attached Form 7 to the registry office.

Article 8 (Methods and Procedures for Exclusion from Performance of Local Government Subsidized Projects)
(1) "Matters prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of the Interior and Safety" in Article 19(5)3 of the Decree means the period during which a local government subsidized operator or a local government subsidy recipient (hereinafter referred to as a "local government subsidized operator, etc.") is excluded from performing local government subsidized projects or restricted from receiving local government subsidies. <Amended on December 13, 2023>
(2) Where a local government subsidized operator, etc. falls under any subparagraph of Article 32(1) or (2) of the Act, the head of the local government shall notify that operator, etc. of the grounds for exclusion from performance of local government subsidized projects or restriction on the grant of local government subsidies and of the period under paragraph (1), and shall provide an opportunity to explain by setting a period within 15 days from the date of notification.
(3) Where the head of a local government deems the outcome of court proceedings necessary to decide whether to exclude a local government subsidized operator, etc. from performing local government subsidized projects or restrict the receipt of local government subsidies, the head may temporarily suspend the procedures for such exclusion or restriction. In such cases, the head shall notify the local government subsidized operator, etc. of the temporary suspension.

Article 9 (Procedures for Imposition of Sanction Surcharges)
When intending to give written notice of the imposition and collection of a sanction surcharge under Article 21(3) of the Decree, the head of a local government shall issue a payment notice in attached Form 8 and send it to the relevant local government subsidized operator, etc. by mail or other means.

ADDENDUM <Ordinance No. 276, September 7, 2021>
This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

ADDENDUM (Ordinance of the Ministry of the Interior and Safety Partially Amending Five Statutes to Improve Forms for Public Convenience) <Ordinance No. 324, March 30, 2022>
This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

ADDENDA <Ordinance No. 438, December 13, 2023>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
Article 2 (Applicability of Exceptions to Preparation of Local Government Subsidized Project Management Cards)
The amended proviso to Article 2(1) shall apply beginning with local government subsidized projects for which a decision to grant local government subsidies is made under Article 8(1) of the Act after this Rule enters into force.

6) Enter "○" where financial transaction or other confirmations were performed, "X" where confirmation subjects existed but confirmation was omitted, and "–" where there were no subjects for confirmation.
7) Where additional external confirmations besides financial transaction, receivable / payable, and lawyer confirmations were performed, enter their details. Examples: confirmations of inventory held elsewhere and securities held elsewhere.
8) Enter the number and dates of communications with those charged with governance. Example: Number: 2 times; dates: October 14, 2014 and February 12, 2015.
9) Enter the specific nature, scope, and details of the work for which external specialists were used. Where external specialists were used on multiple occasions, identify each occasion separately.
